readerCopy.body: Having more power after a period of powerlessness can make any loss of control feel more dangerous than the present situation alone explains. When Pluto conjoins Chiron, leverage and sensitivity fuse, making money, access, authority, information, or another person's decision feel tied to the need to make sure nobody can trap the situation again. Extra safeguards can multiply long after the necessary protection is already in place. Power becomes more useful when it changes the condition that matters instead of trying to eliminate every possible uncertainty.
